annotations.title: Search SEC Form D Newly Funded Startups & Executives

description: Extract newly funded US and cross-border startups from official SEC EDGAR Form D XML filings with USD raised, pooled hedge-fund/real-estate filtering, resolved company domains, and CEO/Founder/Director names (`corridordata/sec-form-d-startup-funding-leads`).

enrichCompanyDomain.description: Automatically resolve root company website domains.

excludePooledFundsAndRealEstate.description: Exclude hedge funds, PE vehicles, and real estate syndications.

filedWithinDays.description: Lookback window in days for SEC EDGAR Form D filings.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of funded startup Form D records to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

minAmountRaisedUsd.description: Minimum USD sold/offering amount (e.g. 500000 for Seed/Series A+).

techAndHealthcareOnly.description: Restrict to Technology, SaaS, AI, Biotech, Pharmaceuticals, and Healthcare issuers.

name: search_funded_startups
